rows.grounds: conclusive particle drawing inference from preceding verses
denotes that of which the supreme goddess is the cause
predicate identifying the supreme goddess as causal principle
refers to the supreme goddess identified with parakuṇḍalī in prior verses

items.question: What establishes the supreme goddess as the ultimate cause of Brahman?
premises: The supreme Kuṇḍalinī is with qualities and the seed of all goddesses.
The supreme goddess is therefore identified as the cause of Brahman.
items.inference: The supreme goddess is the ultimate cause of Brahman.
items.plain_english: Therefore indeed, O great goddess, the supreme one is the cause of Brahman.
